mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.05% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 5.05), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening cycles, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong monthly job growth, as measured by PAYEMS, signals robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth above 100k, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 105.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weak GDP growth and rising inflation signal stagflationary conditions that erode corporate margins and consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 growth < 0 and CPIAUCSL growth > 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts signals the end of the economic cycle and impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion with declining HOUST, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
